purpose: Lints a stablecoin token's declared admin-role configuration for separation of duties, key concentration and issuance-policy fit, over ROLE LABELS ONLY (never addresses or key material). Given a profile (Circle FiatToken, Paxos USDP, or generic caller-declared), holder kinds (eoa, multisig, timelock, hsm_service), a role-to-holder map (owner, proxy_admin, master_minter, pauser, blacklister, rescuer, supply_controller, asset_protection as the profile defines), minter allowances and an issuance policy, it reports: distinctness pairs held by the same label; labels holding multiple critical roles and single-signer holders of critical roles; per-minter and total allowance breaches against the declared ceilings; and whether pause, freeze and upgrade capabilities exist and who holds them. Verdict is PASS, PASS_WITH_FINDINGS or FAIL, each finding cited to the pinned source or marked caller-declared policy. Scope limits: configuration lint only: no live-chain reads, no key custody advice, no statutory claims (no lawful-order or GENIUS Act obligations are asserted); reserve-evidence questions are out of scope (art-06, art-275 cover reserve evidence; art-45 is the sibling linter for Arc xReserve bridge configuration). Any label resembling an address, public key or private key is refused.
